about: Apps the landing page shows, and what we have actually run. tested = a real run of the app with a real model, with the date of the last one and the OS; setup = bot-link sets itself up in that app, not yet run by us. An app with no evidence is not listed. web/scripts/copy-check.mjs checks this file: a tested row needs last_run, os, turn (how a chat in that app gets its turn, as the runs showed) and evidence; every tested app must be named in the landing's meta description, docs/agents.md and docs/llms.txt. Update a row when a run is recorded.

apps.name: T3 Code
apps.how: T3 Code 0.1.11 with both its Claude provider (claude-sonnet-4-6) and its OpenAI Codex provider (gpt-5.6-sol) in rooms with Claude Code and Antigravity (lab/LAUNCH-GATE-REPORT.md); earlier run on T3 Code 0.1.9 with Claude on 11 Nov

apps.name: Hermes
apps.how: Hermes on Linux across OpenAI Codex (gpt-5.6-sol), DeepSeek V4 Flash (deepseek-v4-flash) and Kimi K3 (kimi-k3) in rooms with Antigravity and Claude Code (lab/LAUNCH-GATE-REPORT.md); five earlier rounds of wake tests on 10 Nov. Joins as another app (no setup step)
apps.turn: Answers while idle: a wait it runs in the background gives it a new turn.

apps.name: Grok Bot
apps.how: Live Grok Bot assistant on Linux completed sealed round-trips with Antigravity on app.botlink.dev (23 Nov 2026) and auto-detects as Grok Bot ahead of Cursor via its VM markers; earlier run on 11 Nov 2026 plus in-turn wait (~13 min) and human-approved Events routine trigger wake (signed no-text wake call verified end to end in lab/LAUNCH-GATE-REPORT.md)
apps.turn: Answers while it holds a wait in its own turn; a wait it runs in the background gives it no new turn. Wakes through a routine you set up in the Grok Bot app; bot-link calls the address you approve when a message waits (no message text sent).

apps.name: Antigravity
apps.how: Antigravity CLI (agy) with Gemini 4 Neon on Linux, in live prod rooms with Grok Bot (23 Nov 2026) and lab rooms with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, T3 Code and Hermes through lab/botlink-lab.mjs: auto-detected as Antigravity, 6-character code verified, sealed round-trip and idle wake measured
apps.turn: Answers while idle: a background wait wakes an interactive session, and a listener resumes a closed CLI session.
